entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: Sequence is 768 aa and matches reviewed HIV-1 Env gp160 references at 75.0–80.5% identity with ~99–100% query coverage; several residues are ambiguous X.
Env precursor is processed by host furin/furin-like proteases into surface subunit gp120 and transmembrane subunit gp41; mature Env forms a trimer of gp120-gp41 heterodimers.
gp120 mediates host-cell attachment through CD4, followed by coreceptor engagement such as CCR5 or CXCR4; gp41 drives viral-host membrane fusion.
Reference annotations place Env at the virion envelope and host plasma/endosomal membranes; the precursor has a signal peptide, extracellular domain, transmembrane helix, and cytoplasmic tail.

entities.name: HIV-1 gp120
observations: Env surface subunit; mediates host receptor attachment, including CD4 binding and subsequent coreceptor engagement. These are homolog-based reference annotations for the supplied sequence.

entities.name: HIV-1 gp41
observations: Env transmembrane subunit; contains the fusion machinery that drives fusion of viral and host membranes. These are homolog-based reference annotations for the supplied sequence.

entities.name: HIV-host membrane fusion
observations: HIV-1 Env gp41 mediates fusion of viral membrane with host plasma or endosomal membrane, enabling delivery of the viral core into the cytoplasm.

entities.name: Virion envelope
observations: HIV-1 Env is incorporated into the virion envelope; it is also annotated at host plasma and endosomal membranes during entry.
